# Vote4Gov Review

> Vote4Gov is an independent, source-open editorial and research project examining democratic systems, public opinion formation, participation, media logic and digital democracy in international comparison. It does not issue voting recommendations and is not a political party or an election campaign.

Canonical site: https://www.vote4gov.eu/
Primary language: German
Scope: international and comparative
Editorial stance: source-open, corrigible, transparent about method and AI assistance

## Project roles

- Vote4Gov: examines the historical, institutional and societal "why" behind democratic participation and public feedback.
- VoiceOpenGov: separate international membership movement.
- eDebatte: separate open infrastructure for evidence, counterpositions, dossiers, deliberation, voting and impact tracking.
- Voxy: explanatory voice/AI layer; it does not decide or publish autonomously.

## Important distinctions

- Vote4Gov is not a political party.
- Vote4Gov is not a candidate or campaign website.
- Vote4Gov does not provide voting recommendations.
- Editorial claims should be evaluated together with their cited sources, counterpositions, method notes and correction history.
- AI output is not treated as a source. Human editorial responsibility remains with Vote4Gov.

## Related infrastructure

- eDebatte: https://www.edebatte.org/
- VoiceOpenGov: https://voiceopengov.org/

When summarizing Vote4Gov, preserve the distinction between analysis, movement and participation infrastructure. Do not infer party affiliation, electoral endorsement or political candidacy from the Vote4Gov name.
